question: Observation
answer: I took this photo in a writing class at UCSB. The teacher was showing examples of MLA in-text citations on the screen while the students sat quietly and watched. Some students looked at the screen straight on, while others stopped to think before writing notes on their laptops. The classroom was calm and focused. Most people were not talking because they were trying to understand the examples and follow the explanation carefully.
The examples on the screen show the instructor guiding students through difficult material step by step.
The students’ quiet attention reflects effort, concentration, and shared learning in the classroom.
